title: Chart quiz #13
caption:
Chart quiz #13. How many can you get right?

Q1: Which way will it break?
Q2: Which line is real support?
Q3: Where's the better entry?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #BollingerBands #SupportAndResistance #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Squeezes, support and entries. Question one. The Bollinger Bands have squeezed tight. Which way will it break: up, down, or can't tell? Trick question. You couldn't tell. A squeeze says a bigger move is coming, but not which way. This time it broke down. Wait for the break, then decide. Question two. Price is falling again, with three lines drawn underneath. Which one is real support? A, B, or C? B. Buyers stepped in at that level three times before, so traders are watching it. A and C are just lines on a chart. Question three. Price broke out, ran, and pulled back to the old resistance. Where's the better entry? A, B, or C? B, the retest. A chases the spike, and C buys before anything's confirmed. B is confirmed, and close to a clear stop just under the level. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
